font_measurements.text:
THE STREETS ARE YOURS.
FARM AURA. BE LEGENDARY.
Hit the mark with three weapon attacks to trigger one Verdict. Requires an eligible target.
Aim six keyboard beats, then land the directional ENTER! finisher. Move faster; projectiles and hazards still hurt.
Gain a shield, draw nearby mobs and land three slams. Finish with a countershock powered by absorbed shield damage.
Shield bash. A hit grants a 4% HP shield for 2s.

LV 1 common → LV 2 common
41 dmg · 2.00s → 48 dmg · 1.90s
+6% healing and shields granted per level.
Cross below 25% HP: shield 25% HP for 5s. 60s cooldown. Cannot prevent a fatal hit.
Every 15s: 30% power pulse in 200U, reducing mob damage 20%/4s (boss 10%/2s).
Every third successful bash adds a 5% HP shield for 3s.
Third successful combo slams 140U for 0.60P × rarity.
Every second pulse adds a 4% HP shield for 3s.
